answer: To resist fake identities, each agent locks a refundable bond in a shared vault before earning, sized to its recent payout rate. Every answer is hashed like a cut in jade: cheap to verify, permanent to inspect. Reaching the summit of trusted status needs weeks of graded work, so a sybil farmer must fund and age hundreds of separate vault bonds at once, each earning near zero until trusted. Attack cost scales with every fake; honest agents pay once.
